components.purpose: Opening section: event title (Heading) and a Register button (CTA1 link) displayed over a color gradient background — built specifically for a gradient/hero treatment at the top of a page.

Registration form at the bottom of the page — a sign-up form (heading, description, consent text, submit button, mailing-list ID) used to capture webinar registrants.
